metadata_budget.qualification: Future controller must enforce cumulative metadata cap; remaining 40MiB is not yet a complete measured inventory.

findings: Independent flushed/fsynced event FD preserves synthetic guard failures under stdout/stderr capture, including a background MPS-driver failure.
RSS4GiB, MPSdriver6GiB, disk8GiB and wall7200s limits are unchanged; ordinary worker exceptions and missing or changed result bindings cannot publish completed reports.
Stage binding requires exact hash-bound event/summary agreement; a partial trace remains invalid even if its new hash is supplied.
The existing faster memory watchdog may terminate first; incomplete new traces remain failures and cannot be used for cleanup approval.
limitations: Synthetic observations only. No real MPS initialization, model run, corpus or checkpoint tensor read, or production memory/time validation.
Recorder supplements existing watchdog and serial parent. It does not enforce frozen plan/locks/full future disk fit itself.
No source of closed campaigns or v1 runner acceptance rules changed. No real checkpoint deletion and no failed numerical fixture retry.
Pilot/full-panel gates, campaign-wide inventories, guarded deletion and complete serial runner integration remain outstanding; all nine numerical cases and measured pilots still required.
